subject.title: Feature request: api.callGatewayMethod() for inter-plugin communication

question: Should OpenClaw keep plugin Gateway dispatch limited to bundled/trusted official plugins, or add a supported external plugin-to-plugin call contract?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes the public Plugin SDK and determines whether arbitrary external plugins can invoke Gateway methods, which automation cannot safely decide without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Keep Trusted-Only
options.body: Treat current `api.runtime.gateway.request` as the supported design and require ClawHub/official trust before plugin Gateway dispatch is available.

options.title: Design External Allowlist
options.body: Add an explicit plugin-to-plugin method or capability allowlist with caller attribution, docs, and deny-by-default tests for external plugins.

options.title: Allow Raw Dispatch
options.body: Expose a generic external method-string caller and accept the broader coupling and authorization surface as product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Trusted-Only
recommendation.body: Treat current `api.runtime.gateway.request` as the supported design and require ClawHub/official trust before plugin Gateway dispatch is available.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current constrained implementation and is the strongest history match for the remaining Gateway/plugin security-boundary decision.
